from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Extract yesterday's content and modify it for today by setting practiced_meditation to no
content_yesterday = note_content_yesterday["content"]
lines = content_yesterday.split("\n")
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith("practiced_meditation:"):
        new_lines.append("practiced_meditation: no")
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)
content_today = "\n".join(new_lines)

# Prepare today's date and title for the new note
today_date = (datetime.strptime(note_content_yesterday["created_at"][:10], "%Y-%m-%d") + timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
title_today = f"Habit Tracker Log for {today_date}"

# Create the new note with modified content for today
create_note_response = apis.simple_note.create_note(access_token=access_token, title=title_today, content=content_today, tags=[])
